lines.en: Maybe I’ll see what Haruka is up to?
Now that I think about it, the two of us haven’t really hung out except for that one time she gave me a ride home.
And even then it was more along the lines of just...getting to her house and leaving a few minutes later.
Besides, she wouldn’t have given me her number if she didn’t want to actually talk, right?
Not knowing what else to do, I tap on Haruka’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: Hello?
: Hey, it’s-
: I know who it is. I've had your name in my phone since I asked you to check on Rin for me.
: And you haven't bothered calling? Do you even like me?
: Hey, you haven't called either!
: Is everything okay, though? Is this about Rin again? Because she seemed fine earlier today and-
: Everything is fine. I was just wondering what you were doing tonight.
: Tonight? I was going to hang out at Sara’s bar.
: Do you...want to come or something?
: Sure. If you guys are cool with having me.
: I'm sure we are, but let me check anyway! Hold on a sec.
A moment of silence passes by as Haruka does...whatever.
: Sara says you're free to come so long as you spend a lot of money.
: What if I just come, spend a normal amount of money, and keep you company?
: Hmm...well, I do seem like the loneliest person at the bar...
: You’re probably the only customer at the bar in general.
: Also correct. So, are you going to come over now, or?...
: Yeah, I’m on my way. Don't get too drunk without me.
: What's that? You want me to get super drunk without you? I mean...I wasn't going to but, if you insist-
: Haruka-
: Byeeeeee~!
Well, Haruka seems a bit...livelier than normal today.
I just hope that she doesn't actually wind up getting too drunk while I'm on my way over since dealing with her and Sara that way sounds...hard.
Maybe I'll try walking a little faster than normal...
I take a moment to straighten out my clothes before making my way inside.
I'm sure no one cares, but it is one of the exceedingly rare opportunities I have to be alone with people actually close to my age and I should at least look the part of a mature human being.
Even if my companions for the evening will see me as one giant blur...
: Heeeeey! You made it! I’m not alone anymore!
: I’ve been here with you the entire time...
: Hey, you two. What’s up?
I take a seat next to Haruka, whose face has already gone full-blush from drinking.
Sara is busy wiping down the counter in front of us and, surprisingly enough, doesn't seem drunk at all.
Which I guess means this will, at least for the time being, be a decently lopsided conversation in which we counteract...however Haruka is when she's drunk.
: How was your walk, man? See anything cool along the way?
: Maybe like a...huge stick or something?
I immediately understand how Haruka is when she's drunk.
: It was a normal walk. I didn’t see anything particularly notable.
: Cool, cool. Normal walk. Got it.
: Great icebreaker, Haru-chan.
: So...you two are friends? Or...
: Don’t talk to her, man. She's drunk.
: I haven’t even had anything to drink yet...
: Yeah, Haruka. I’ve seen Sara drunk and she-
: Shhhh...You and me are talking right now. She’s just a bartender. It’s my turn to have you.
: I...probably should have cut her off after five, huh?
: Haruka, you had five beers in the time it took me to get here?
: I called you like fifteen minutes ago.
: Five? That’s it? Pfft. Gimme five more. I got this.
: Sara’s the one who gets drunk off five beers. I can go all night, if you know what I mean.
: Oh, wait! I didn’t mean it like that. Hahahahah!
: You’re so naughty, Sensei!
: I didn’t even say anything...
: Oh, you didn’t? Does that mean I'm...imagining things?...
: I’m so sorry...
Sara whispers across the table as if to say something along the lines of “I had a feeling this might happen” or “I could have prevented this.”
But the truth is, I really don’t mind.
Would I have minded if she was a less horny drunk? Possibly. But this seems like a pretty great turn of events for me.
Besides, Haruka works hard enough as-is. It’s probably nice for her to take a load off like this every once in a while.
: Can I get a beer, Sara?
: Oh, shoot! I forgot to even ask.
: I’ll be right back. I just need to grab some from upstairs since Haru-chan finished everything down here.
: And...why exactly do you keep the beer in your apartment instead of in the bar?
: Cause it's a lot less fun drinking myself to sleep if I have to keep walking downstairs.
: Now hang out for just a sec and don’t take advantage of my friend while I’m gone.
Sara disappears upstairs and, moments later, I can hear her footsteps as she moves through her apartment.
It makes me realize exactly how old this place must be if I can hear something like that even with the...jazzy piano music playing in the background.
: Heheh~
: What?
: Hah...heheheh...
: What’s so funny?
: Heheheh...
: Haruka, explain your-
: You two had sex with each other~
: Yes. That is a thing that happened.
: You put your penis inside of my friend.
: That would be how sex works, yes.
: Did it feel good?
: It normally does.
: You gonna do it again?
: Why do you ask, Haruka?
: I don’t knooooow...curiosity?
: Are you looking for an invitation?
: Maybe you can just film it and send it to me so I can watch it at home?
: I’ll bring it up to Sara next time.
: Dude, I was kidding!
: I tooooootally don’t wanna watch you fuck my friend. That's like...so gross...
: Who’s watching what now?
Sara shows back up out of virtually nowhere and winks at me. There’s not a doubt in my mind that she at least heard the tail end of that.
In other news, though, I think I need to buy a video camera.
: Shhh. Don’t tell her what we talked about. It’s a secret.
: Is it really a secret if Sara already told you about us?
: Hm? What about us? What did I tell you, Haru-chan?
: Look! You’re gonna get me in trouble!
: I’m not going to do anything that you weren’t going to do yourself.
I can’t help but notice Haruka stare off into the distance as soon as Sara disappears.
She grows rather quiet compared to how she was just moments ago and it’s...actually kind of confusing.
I'm assuming that something is bothering her, but it wouldn't be right for me to just-
: She’s so pretty, isn’t she?
Okay. I guess I'm going to find out after all.
: Sara?
: Mhm.
: I mean...Yeah. She’s attractive. Why?
Haruka lets out a heavy sigh, eyes still locked on where her friend stood just moments ago.
: Why didn’t you have sex with her?
: What?
: Didn’t you turn her down when she was basically throwing herself at you? Why?
: Not to be rude, but how does that involve you?
: It doesn’t...but it’s confusing.
: Sara seemed pretty popular when we were in[school]. She was the kind of girl that everybody just, like...knew. I was honestly really jealous of her.
: I never even had a boyfriend until I turned 18. And even then...
: Heheh...actually...it’s not like any of my story involves you. So I’ll just stop there...
: Okay! Supermom has returned!
: Did you two get along well while I was upstairs? Is anyone pregnant yet?
: Yeah. We’re having twins. We need your help choosing names.
: How about...Sana and Sara?
: That...wouldn't bother you? Because it probably-
: Hey. Wait a second.
: Where is my beer?
: In the cooler, silly. It needs to get cold.
: How can you provide such horrible customer service with a smile on your face?
: Maybe I'm still a little mad that somebody rejected me in my time of need?
: What?
: Hm? I didn’t say anything.
: Apologies, sir. But you’re just going to have to deal with it. Please don’t cause a scene in front of my other customers.
Right. Forgot about all of her customers.
: Fine. Whatever. I’ll just have some of Haruka’s.
I go to reach for Haruka’s beer and-
: Nuh-uh! No you won’t! This one’s all mine. You’re gonna have to wait for your own.
: But that’s your sixth one and I'm stuck at zero for the foreseeable future.
: So?
: So that’s plenty. You’re not planning on driving home, are you?
: I didn't even bring my car. I’m gonna sleep here tonight~
: You are?
: You are?
: Isn't this a thing I should have known about?
: I just decided right now.
: This is the first time I’ve been with two friends in forever and I want to drink and have more fun.
: Aww...Haru-chan is actually being cute and not just horny and lonely for once! What a rare and wonderful sight.
: I’m in. Let’s all get drunk and talk about our feelings!
: Yay!~
: Feelings? What are those?
Sara runs upstairs for more alcohol and, like you may have guessed, the three of us spend the next couple hours getting drunk and talking about our “feelings.”
Well, those two talk. I just sit there, sipping on warm beer and waiting for one of them to get drunk enough to pass out.
With a six-beer head start, the winner is Haruka.
Sara, who is in no condition to help when the time comes for us to start wrapping things up, stumbles her way up the stairs and presumably into her bed shortly after.
And I-
I wind up dealing with this.
: Haruka.
: Haruka...
: Mmm...
Haruka’s been passed out for around twenty minutes at this point.
Knowing that the bar is closed and that no one is around to really...capitalize on this situation, I likely could just leave her here without any consequences...
But something about my involvement causes me to feel the slightest bit guilty.
And so I will continue to shake her shoulder until she wakes up.
: Haruka. Live.
: You can’t die here. It would be far too depressing.
: Mmm...
I suddenly feel her body begin to move against my hand as she attempts to pull herself off of the counter...
: What?...
: What happened?...
: You got drunk.
: I did?...
: Very drunk, actually. Sara’s not doing so well right now either.
: In fact, she-
: Shut up.
: What?
: I said shut up.
: Okay.
: Mmnh~!
: Mmm...ngh...mnh~ Angh~ mmf~ Mmf!
Haruka’s tongue violently assaults my own as if to make up for all of the time she's missed with the man she actually loves.
Or is pretending to love, based on how passionately she's currently gulping down my saliva.
The aggression behind just this single kiss is terrifying and, I know it sounds strange, but it feels like she's essentially trying to suffocate me.
I instinctively reach for one of her breasts and attempt to wrap my hand around it, not being able to cover it all due to the sheer size.
She leans into me, keeping her eyes closed to remain lost in whatever fantasy she'll use to justify this when the time comes to do so.
In between her gasps, I feel the lustful hesitance to reach downward and put an end to her loneliness right here and now.
I think about helping her, but not for long.
If I forget about breathing for even a second, she is sure to end me.
: Mmm...ngh...chu...mf...mlem...ngh...hah...ahm...
: Mmm...mmm~ MMM!
: Hm...mm...nnh...
: Mmnch...mmm!
: Mmh...
: Oh my god.
: Oh my god...
: Oh god oh god oh god...
: I have to go.
: I’m so sorry.
Haruka pushes me away and nearly falls out of the chair as she tries to climb out.
She’s still too drunk to run, so she awkwardly stumbles away, grabbing on to everything she can in a desperate attempt to reach the stairs.
I don’t call out to her.
I get too caught up in watching her struggle.
Haruka’s affection increased by 1 more than she wants it to.
